note: Measured on a task-owned TouchDesigner 2025.32460 under Wine, scratch project copied from the shipped template.toe. Every capture below returned its true encoded PNG size in the result text. This is a MEASURED WORKLOAD SAMPLE, not a frozen distribution: it is a resolution ladder over one noise source, and it says nothing about HDR/EXR captures or photographic content. It is published so the admission default can be argued against numbers instead of against a recollection.

observations.note: maxSize 0 downscales to a 1x1px preview rather than to native. A caller asking for the smallest thing still gets a well-formed image.
512 is CAPTURE_DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE, so this is the size a capture costs when the caller passes nothing.
The hard cap rung: the most a PNG capture can cost at CAPTURE_MAX_SIZE.

An 8K source downscaled to the cap costs LESS than the same cap applied to a 1080p source, because the downscale is an average and averaging smooths noise. Delivered dimensions, not source resolution, drive the byte cost.
Portrait at the cap. The largest observation in this sample.
Native, because 720p is already under the cap. Not transformed.
